WITH MediaTypeStats AS (
  SELECT 
    mt.Name,
    CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS DECIMAL(18,10)) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS DECIMAL(18,10)) as BytesPerMillisecond
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
AverageStats AS (
  SELECT AVG(BytesPerMillisecond) as AvgBytesPerMS
  FROM MediaTypeStats
)
SELECT 
  mts.Name,
  mts.BytesPerMillisecond,
  mts.BytesPerMillisecond / ast.AvgBytesPerMS as RatioToAverage
FROM MediaTypeStats mts
CROSS JOIN AverageStats ast
ORDER BY mts.Name
